nodes.title: SELECT ONE PERSON - position + short description
2. DIRECT PROMPT / OPTIONAL ROLE BUILDER
widgets_values: Create a four-panel photographic character sheet of the same person in the references, showing front, three-quarter, side and back views. Preserve identity and natural proportions. These are generated interpretations, not source photographs.

nodes.title: READ THE EXACT PROMPT BEFORE RENDERING

SAMPLE - change run_label to repeat cached test
A. RAW H3 - inspect before compositing
B. FINAL - protected only when mask option is ON
START HERE
widgets_values:
H3 STUDIO LAB. Existing models and login remain unchanged. No model downloads happen when opening this graph.
First test the unchanged 00 baseline. Keep the same seed, photographs and prompt for A/B tests. Change run_label to force another timed sample; preparation may be cached.
One output_megapixels value controls the selected mode, including Replace person. Supporting photos have their own crop and MP nodes. Previews are before the native match/max reference resize; the report shows final reference dimensions.
Role builder is literal text assembly, not an LLM. Turn it OFF to paste your successful prompt unchanged. Face/body roles are instructions, not hard identity locks.
All optional personal LoRAs are OFF. Experimental graph presets request exactly one experiment. Spectrum and Spark change the numerical trajectory; do not assume a speedup or likeness improvement.
Generated turnaround views may invent unseen anatomy. Use original photographs as the identity authority.
